findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "samuelz-chauffeur" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quote_ride, resolve_offer_attempt · Private data: quote_ride, prepare_offer, get_offer_status, resolve_offer_attempt · Public sink: quote_ride, prepare_offer · Destructive: resolve_offer_attempt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quote_ride, resolve_offer_attempt · Private data: quote_ride, prepare_offer, get_offer_status, resolve_offer_attempt · Public sink: quote_ride, prepare_offer · Destructive: resolve_offer_attempt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quote_ride" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
